service.description: Generic MCP entrypoint for JSON-RPC requests. Dispatches core MCP protocol methods to Moqui services.

actions.script: Map<String, String> methodMap = [ 'server/discover' : 'org.moqui.mcp.McpServices.server#Discover', 'tools/list' : 'org.moqui.mcp.McpServices.list#Tools', 'tools/call' : 'org.moqui.mcp.McpServices.call#Tool', 'resources/list' : 'org.moqui.mcp.McpServices.list#Resources', 'resources/get' : 'org.moqui.mcp.McpServices.get#Resource', 'prompts/list' : 'org.moqui.mcp.McpServices.list#Prompts', 'prompts/get' : 'org.moqui.mcp.McpServices.get#Prompt', 'subscriptions/listen' : 'org.moqui.mcp.McpServices.subscriptions#Listen' ] String serviceName = methodMap[method] if (!serviceName) { ec.message.addError("Unsupported MCP method: ${method}") return } Map callParams = (params instanceof Map) ? new LinkedHashMap(params) : [:] Map svcRes = ec.service.sync().name(serviceName).parameters(callParams).call() if (ec.message.hasError()) { String err = ec.message.errorsString ec.message.clearErrors() throw new IllegalArgumentException(err) } result = svcRes?.result ?: svcRes

service.description: Return MCP discovery metadata for the Moqui MCP server.

actions.script: result = [ resultType: 'complete', supportedVersions: ['2026-07-28'], capabilities: [ tools: [listChanged: true], resources: [listChanged: true], prompts: [:] ], _meta: [ 'io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo': [ name: 'Moqui MCP Server', version: '3.0.0' ] ], ttlMs: 3600000, cacheScope: 'private' ]

service.description: List MCP tools exposed by built-in Moqui services and registered provider services.

actions.script:
import groovy.json.JsonSlurper
List<Map> toolList = [ [ name: 'moqui_search_data_documents', title: 'Search Data Documents', description: 'Run text search against Moqui DataDocument indexes in OpenSearch. Use this for all business lookups before calling mutating services.', inputSchema: [ type: 'object', properties: [ indexName: [type: 'string', description: 'OpenSearch index name'], documentType: [type: 'string', description: 'Optional DataDocument identifier'], queryString: [type: 'string', description: 'Lucene/Elastic query string'], pageIndex: [type: 'integer'], pageSize: [type: 'integer'] ], required: ['indexName', 'queryString'] ] ], [ name: 'moqui_call_service', title: 'Call Moqui Service', description: 'Invoke an existing Moqui service by full service name with explicit parameters. Use only after required identifiers and enumerations have been resolved.', inputSchema: [ type: 'object', properties: [ serviceName: [type: 'string', description: 'Full Moqui service name'], parameters: [type: 'object', description: 'Input parameter map'] ], required: ['serviceName'] ] ], [ name: 'moqui_make_notification', title: 'Create Notification Message', description: 'Create a Moqui notification message using the standard NotificationMessage mechanism.', inputSchema: [ type: 'object', properties: [ topic: [type: 'string'], subTopic: [type: 'string'], userId: [type: 'string'], userGroupId: [type: 'string'], type: [type: 'string'], title: [type: 'string'], message: [type: 'object'] ], required: ['topic'] ] ] ]
def jsonSlurper = new JsonSlurper() ec.entity.find('moqui.service.ServiceRegister').condition('serviceTypeEnumId', 'McpToolProvider').useCache(true).list()?.each { providerReg -> try { Map cfg = [:] if (providerReg.configParameters) cfg = (Map) jsonSlurper.parseText(providerReg.configParameters) Map providerRes = ec.service.sync().name(providerReg.serviceName as String).call() List<Map> providerTools = (providerRes?.toolList ?: providerRes?.tools ?: []) as List<Map> toolList.addAll(providerTools) } catch (Throwable t) { ec.logger.warn("Unable to load MCP tools from provider ${providerReg.serviceRegisterId}: ${t.message}") } }
result = [tools: toolList]

service.description: Call a built-in MCP tool or dispatch to a registered MCP tool provider.
List core Moqui MCP resources: entity schemas and data document definitions.

actions.script: List<Map> resourceList = [] for (String entityName in (ec.entity.getAllEntityNames() ?: [])) { resourceList.add([ uri: "entity://${entityName}", name: entityName, mimeType: 'application/json', description: "Moqui entity schema for ${entityName}" ]) } ec.entity.find('moqui.entity.document.DataDocument').useCache(true).list()?.each { dd -> resourceList.add([ uri: "datadocument://${dd.dataDocumentId}", name: dd.dataDocumentId, mimeType: 'application/json', description: dd.description ?: "Moqui DataDocument ${dd.dataDocumentId}" ]) } result = [resources: resourceList]

service.description: Get a resource by URI. Supports entity schema resources, single record resources, and data document definitions.
List prompt templates stored as Wiki pages in the configured MCP wiki space.
Get a prompt template from a Wiki page.

actions.script: String promptText = wikiResult?.pageText ?: wikiResult?.text ?: '' result = [ name: name, messages: [[role: 'system', content: [type: 'text', text: promptText]]] ]

service.description: Register notification interest for a client session. The transport-specific bridge can use these rows to forward NotificationMessage events.

actions.script: Map existing = ec.entity.find('moqui.mcp.McpSubscription') .condition('userId', ec.user.userId) .condition('sessionId', sessionId) .condition('subscriptionType', subscriptionType) .condition('topicPattern', topicPattern) .one() if (existing) { existing.lastUpdatedDate = ec.user.nowTimestamp existing.statusId = 'McpSubActive' existing.update() result = [subscriptionId: existing.mcpSubscriptionId, status: 'updated'] } else { Map createMap = [ mcpSubscriptionId: ec.entity.sequencedIdPrimary('moqui.mcp.McpSubscription', null, null), userId: ec.user.userId, sessionId: sessionId, subscriptionType: subscriptionType, topicPattern: topicPattern, protocolVersion: protocolVersion, statusId: 'McpSubActive', createdDate: ec.user.nowTimestamp, lastUpdatedDate: ec.user.nowTimestamp ] ec.entity.makeValue('moqui.mcp.McpSubscription').setAll(createMap).create() result = [subscriptionId: createMap.mcpSubscriptionId, status: 'created'] }
